analysis.evidence: רְבִיעִי identifies the fourth generation in a line of descent. The plural verb יָשׁוּבוּ (“they will return”) refers to the descendants who make up that generation.
analysis.morphology: The conjunction וְ (“and”) prefixes a masculine singular absolute noun. The ordinal רְבִיעִי (“fourth”) agrees with it in gender and number.

analysis.evidence: In וְדוֹר רְבִיעִי, רְבִיעִי modifies דּוֹר and identifies the fourth generation as the one that will return here (יָשׁוּבוּ הֵנָּה).
analysis.morphology: Masculine singular absolute ordinal adjective agreeing with דּוֹר.

analysis.evidence: הֵנָּה means “here” and gives the destination. The fourth generation of Abram’s descendants will return to the land where Abram is.
analysis.morphology: Qal imperfect, third person masculine plural. The plural refers to the members of the fourth generation, and the imperfect predicts their return.
analysis.sense: return to one’s place of origin

analysis.evidence: In יָשׁוּבוּ הֵנָּה, “they will return here,” הֵנָּה identifies the destination of the fourth generation’s return.
analysis.morphology: Hebrew directional adverb with no prefix or suffix.

analysis.evidence: כִּי introduces the reason for the timing of the return. The fourth generation will return here, for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet complete.
analysis.morphology: Uninflected Hebrew conjunction with no prefix or suffix.

analysis.evidence: לֹא negates שָׁלֵם ‘complete’. With עַד הֵנָּה ‘up to now’, the clause says that the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet complete.
analysis.morphology: Hebrew negative particle with no prefix or suffix.

analysis.evidence: לֹא negates שָׁלֵם, and עַד הֵנָּה means “up to now.” The Amorite’s guilt has yet to reach its full measure, which explains why the return awaits the fourth generation.
analysis.morphology: Masculine singular absolute adjective functioning as the predicate of עֲון הָאֱמֹרִי, agreeing with עֲון in gender and number.
analysis.sense: Full in measure, describing the extent of the Amorite’s guilt.
